description: Simulates the impact of a collateral price drop on all active EVM lending positions for a wallet (Aave V3/V4, Spark, Morpho, Euler, Moonwell). Formula: newHF = currentHF × (1 − drop%). Shows per-position health factor changes and flags which positions would move to AT RISK, DANGER, or LIQUIDATED. Use this when asked: "What happens to this wallet if ETH drops 30%?", "Would this wallet survive a 40% market crash?", "Stress-test this address at -20% collateral", "Which positions are closest to liquidation if the market drops?"

collateral_drop_pct.description: Percentage drop in collateral value to simulate, e.g. 30 for a 30% price crash. Range: 1–80.

wallet.description: EVM wallet address — must start with 0x and be exactly 42 characters, e.g. 0xabc…1234

name: simulate_liquidation

allSurvived.description: True if every position survives the simulated drop

atRiskCount.description: Positions that would move to AT RISK or DANGER tier

simulatedHF.description: Health factor after the simulated drop

tierChanged.description: True if the risk tier worsened

title: Simulate Liquidation
